note: PROVISIONAL: the E0 preflight and the user set these (rho_star, a_phi, a_omega, D, T, patterns). Single-length rho_star normalization: the E x B bracket and the curvature term carry rho_star, the polarization is Omega = rho_star^2 lap_perp(phi + tau p_i), diffusion is unchanged. The manufactured vorticity is Omega = a_omega rho_star^2 Omega_shape(x, t) so that its size matches the polarization (an O(1) Omega gives a spurious linear mode with rate ~ 1/rho_star); a_omega is provisional, set from the t = 0 statistics rms|lap_cont psi| / rms|Omega_shape| = 2192 on the filtered N32 bundle (rms|lap_cont psi| = 862, rms|Omega_shape| = 0.393), rounded to two significant digits. P10 is the MMS correctness test only (consistency of the evolved pipeline at physical rho_star; T = 1/30, time_scale = 1, so Re(lambda) T << 1); stability is assessed separately with the parallel operators (user, 6 October 2026). D and a_phi are set by the E0 preflight so that each operator's integrated truncation stays well above the O - R floor.
nsteps_rule: ceil(50 sqrt(N / 32)): 50 steps at N32 (O - R / N - R ~ 1e-4 in the E0 smoke runs); RK4 time error ~ dt^4 kept proportional to the O(h^2) spatial error, so dt ~ h^(1/2) (dt / sqrt(2) per doubling of N) (user, 6 October 2026)
T_note: 1 / 30 in t_ref = L_ref / c_s0 (user, 6 October 2026: physical rho_star, fixed T, no time stretch)
w1_note: W1 variant flag: 1.0 adds the eta-harmonic-2 switch term to Omega (reported-only case)
